newsitem.title: USA: Florida judge tells UPS, union to set picket rules.
newsitem.headline: Florida judge tells UPS, union to set picket rules.

text.p: A Florida judge scolded union and UPS lawyers on Friday and ordered them to negotiate an agreement to govern picketing of UPS facilities in Florida's Dade County by striking Teamsters workers.

Dade County Circuit Court Judge Ronald Friedman told lawyers for UPS, or United Parcel Service, they should have informed Teamsters lawyers before a week ago seeking an injunction limiting the number of pickets to five at UPS sites in Dade County. That order was issued by another judge in Friedman's absence.
Friedman also told a Teamsters lawyer who objected to last week's order that he must agree that any court order include a ban on violence.
Before dismissing the lawyers to begin immediate negotiations on an agreed order, Friedman said, "I will decide, if you don't. You may like it or you may not."
